title: FAA's Fiber Line Fiasco, America Threatens to Ground Iran's Airlines, and Air New Zealand Pilots Throw Hands in San Francisco
summary: A cut fiber cable takes down the Northeast's airspace and cancels over a thousand flights in one day. Plus, the US threatens to cut off fuel to any airport that services Iranian planes, two Air New Zealand pilots get into it on a layover and strand a planeful of passengers for 14 hours, and American's building a four-and-a-half-billion-dollar terminal in Phoenix.
